prompt: A slow, gentle push-in from behind the desk toward the masked commentator. He keeps the binoculars pressed to his mask; on the start he gives a small, sudden lean forward, shoulders tensing, then follows the runners with steady little turns of the head from left to right. His free gloved hand rises briefly to steady the binoculars with both hands. Rain streaks the window and the green course stretches away behind. Mask, gloves and tweed stay exactly as in the first frame. Sound: rain on glass, papers rustling, a distant crowd swell and hooves, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
